autoCompleteNotReady: Available when stock and waste are empty

tutorial.stockWaste: Click the stock to draw one card. When the stock runs out you may redeal the waste once.
tutorial.foundation: Build 8 foundation piles by suit from Ace to King.
tutorial.tableau: 8 tableau columns of 5 cards. Move single cards in descending order of the same suit. Any card can fill an empty column.
tutorial.controls: Use redeal, hint, undo, and auto-complete buttons.
